title: Record stock movement

directionHint.LOST: A loss decreases the recorded quantity.

stockHint: To add stock, close a purchase invoice. Stock is never added here.

form.remarkRequired: Please choose what happened to the stock.

errors.reasonNotStandalone: PURCHASE and SOLD movements exist only through invoice closing; returns use the return endpoint.
errors.lossCarriesNoInvoiceData: LOST and DESTROYED movements carry no invoice item or prices.
errors.lossRequiresRemark: LOST and DESTROYED movements require a remark.
errors.unitCostDerived: Unit cost is derived from the invoice item and must not be supplied.
errors.remarkForbidden: A remark explains a loss and must not be supplied for {{reason}} movements.
errors.invoiceTypeMismatch: {{reason}} movements must reference a {{requiredType}} invoice item.
errors.invoiceOpen: Movements cannot be recorded against an open invoice.
errors.itemProductMismatch: Invoice item {{invoiceItemId}} belongs to a different product.
errors.quantityMismatch: Movement quantity must equal the invoice item quantity ({{quantity}}).
errors.alreadyRecorded: A {{reason}} movement already exists for invoice item {{invoiceItemId}}.
errors.returnRequiresSaleMovement: A customer return requires the stock movement of the sale it reverses.
